host.autoresizingMask = sourceView.autoresizingMask

host.alpha = 0

if let parent = sourceView.superview { parent.insertSubview(host, aboveSubview: sourceView) } else { sourceView.addSubview(host) }

sourceHostView = host


let layer = host.displayLayer

layer.videoGravity = .resizeAspect

var timebase: CMTimebase?

let status = CMTimebaseCreateWithSourceClock(allocator: kCFAllocatorDefault, sourceClock: CMClockGetHostTimeClock(), timebaseOut: &timebase)

guard status == noErr, let timebase else {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "prepare failed reason=timebase status=\(status)")

reset(reason: "timebase-failed")

return

}

syncTimebase(timebase, to: clock.position(), playing: behavior.playback == .playing)

layer.controlTimebase = timebase

controlTimebase = timebase

displayLayer = layer


let contentSource = AVPictureInPictureController.ContentSource(sampleBufferDisplayLayer: layer, playbackDelegate: self)

let systemController = AVPictureInPictureController(contentSource: contentSource)

systemController.delegate = self

systemController.requiresLinearPlayback = false

controller = systemController

observePossible(systemController)


firstVisibleSampleEnqueued = false

sourceSurfaceRevealed = false

let activePipeline = PlayerPiPSamplePipeline(session: session, startPosition: clock.position())

pipeline = activePipeline

bindActivePipeline(activePipeline)

activePipeline.setPaused(behavior.playback != .playing)

activeGeneration = activePipeline.start()

scheduleStartTimeout()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "session prepared playback=\(behavior.playback.rawValue) presentation=\(behavior.presentation.rawValue) position=\(String(format: "%.3f", clock.position())) generation=\(activeGeneration) renderer=\(inlineRenderer == nil ? "none" : "engine-or-surface")")

}


private func bindActivePipeline(_ activePipeline: PlayerPiPSamplePipeline) {

activePipeline.onReady = { info in DispatchQueue.main.async { DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPPipeline", "active ready \(info)") } }

activePipeline.onFailure = { [weak self, weak activePipeline] reason in DispatchQueue.main.async {

guard let self, self.pipeline === activePipeline else { return }

self.handlePipelineFailure(reason)

} }

activePipeline.onSample = { [weak self, weak activePipeline] envelope in DispatchQueue.main.async {

guard let self, let activePipeline, self.pipeline === activePipeline else { return }

self.handleActivePipelineSample(envelope)

} }

}


private func handleActivePipelineSample(_ envelope: PlayerPiPSamplePipeline.SampleEnvelope) {

guard let displayLayer, displayLayer.status != .failed else { handleDisplayLayerFailure(); return }


if let fallbackGeneration = fallbackSeekGeneration, envelope.generation == fallbackGeneration {

fallbackSeekSamples.append(envelope)

if fallbackSeekSamples.count > 80 { fallbackSeekSamples.removeFirst(fallbackSeekSamples.count - 80) }

if envelope.displayable { commitSeekVisual(using: fallbackSeekSamples, authoritative: currentAuthoritativeSeekPosition() ?? envelope.pts, promotedPipeline: nil, token: activeSeekToken, source: "active-fallback") }

return

}


guard envelope.generation == activeGeneration else { return }

displayLayer.enqueue(envelope.buffer)

guard envelope.displayable else { return }

sourceHostView?.markVideoAvailable()

if !firstVisibleSampleEnqueued {

firstVisibleSampleEnqueued = true

clock.reset(position: envelope.pts, playing: behavior.playback == .playing)

syncTimebaseToClock()

revealSourceSurfaceIfNeeded()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "first-visible-sample pts=\(String(format: "%.3f", envelope.pts)) generation=\(envelope.generation) key=\(envelope.keyframe)")

pollStart(attempt: 0)

}

}


private func handleDisplayLayerFailure() {

if let error = displayLayer?.error { DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "display-layer failed error=\(error.localizedDescription)") }

handlePipelineFailure("display-layer-failed")

}


private func revealSourceSurfaceIfNeeded() {

guard !sourceSurfaceRevealed, let host = sourceHostView else { return }

sourceSurfaceRevealed = true

UIView.performWithoutAnimation { host.alpha = 1; host.layoutIfNeeded() }

}


private func observePossible(_ systemController: AVPictureInPictureController) {

possibleObservation = systemController.observe(\.isPictureInPicturePossible, options: [.initial, .new]) { [weak self] controller, _ in DispatchQueue.main.async {

guard let self else { return }

self.onPossibleChanged?(controller.isPictureInPicturePossible || AVPictureInPictureController.isPictureInPictureSupported())

self.startIfReady()

} }

}


private func pollStart(attempt: Int) {

startPoll?.cancel()

guard behavior.presentation == .preparing else { return }

startIfReady()

guard behavior.presentation == .preparing, attempt < 80 else { return }

let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in self?.pollStart(attempt: attempt + 1) }

startPoll = work

DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.05, execute: work)

}


private func startIfReady() {

guard behavior.presentation == .preparing, firstVisibleSampleEnqueued, sourceSurfaceRevealed, let controller, let displayLayer else { return }

guard controller.isPictureInPicturePossible, displayLayer.status != .failed else { return }

startPoll?.cancel(); startPoll = nil

behavior.presentation = .starting

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-start begin playback=\(behavior.playback.rawValue) sourceSurface=visible")

controller.startPictureInPicture()

}


private func scheduleStartTimeout() {

startTimeout?.cancel()

let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in

guard let self, self.behavior.presentation == .preparing || self.behavior.presentation == .starting else { return }

self.failAndRecover(reason: "start-timeout")

}

startTimeout = work

DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 5.0, execute: work)

}


private func requestHomeAfterSystemStart() {

guard !homeRequested else { return }

homeRequested = true

let requested = homeCoordinator.requestHome()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "home-request issued=\(requested) policy=didStart rendererStillInline=true")

}


private func handleBackgroundEntered() {

guard controller?.isPictureInPictureActive == true, behavior.presentation == .active || behavior.presentation == .returning else { return }

guard !inlineRendererSuspended, !rendererSuspending, let inlineRenderer else { return }

rendererSuspending = true

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "renderer suspend begin phase=didEnterBackground")

inlineRenderer.suspendInlineRendererForPictureInPicture { [weak self] success in

guard let self else { return }

self.rendererSuspending = false

self.inlineRendererSuspended = success

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "renderer suspend success=\(success)")

if UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active { self.handleForegroundActive() }

}

}


private func handleForegroundActive() {

let pendingRestore = pendingForegroundRendererRestore

pendingForegroundRendererRestore = nil

pendingRestore?()

guard controller?.isPictureInPictureActive == true, behavior.presentation == .active, behavior.exitIntent == .none, homeRequested else { return }

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "foreground return detected intent=returnToPlayer")

beginReturnToPlayer(reason: "app-foreground", systemCompletion: nil, manualForeground: true)

}


private func restoreInlineRendererWhenForeground(targetPosition: Double, completion: @escaping (Bool, Double?) -> Void) {

guard !rendererSuspending else {

pendingForegroundRendererRestore = { [weak self] in self?.restoreInlineRendererWhenForeground(targetPosition: targetPosition, completion: completion) }

return

}

guard inlineRendererSuspended else { completion(true, playbackController?.snapshot.position); return }

guard UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active else {

pendingForegroundRendererRestore = { [weak self] in self?.restoreInlineRendererWhenForeground(targetPosition: targetPosition, completion: completion) }

return

}

guard let inlineRenderer else { inlineRendererSuspended = false; completion(false, nil); return }

inlineRenderer.resumeInlineRendererAfterPictureInPicture(targetPosition: targetPosition) { [weak self] success, actualPosition in

guard let self else { completion(success, actualPosition); return }

if success { self.inlineRendererSuspended = false }

completion(success, actualPosition)

}

}


private func beginReturnToPlayer(reason: String, systemCompletion: ((Bool) -> Void)?, manualForeground: Bool) {

guard behavior.playback != .stopped else { systemCompletion?(false); return }

if behavior.exitIntent == .closePlayback || behavior.exitIntent == .detach { systemCompletion?(false); return }

behavior.exitIntent = .returnToPlayer

behavior.presentation = .returning

manualForegroundReturn = manualForeground

if let systemCompletion {

pendingRestoreUICompletion?(false)

pendingRestoreUICompletion = systemCompletion

}

returnRendererReady = false

returnRendererRestoreInProgress = false

returnActualPosition = nil

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.beginPictureInPictureRestoreOrientationHold()

AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.preparePictureInPictureRestoreDestination()

let target = clock.position()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "return begin reason=\(reason) target=\(String(format: "%.3f", target)) manual=\(manualForeground) systemCompletion=\(systemCompletion != nil)")

beginReturnRendererRestore(targetPosition: target)

pollReturnBarrier(attempt: 0)

}


private func beginReturnRendererRestore(targetPosition: Double) {

guard !returnRendererReady, !returnRendererRestoreInProgress else { return }

returnRendererRestoreInProgress = true

restoreInlineRendererWhenForeground(targetPosition: targetPosition) { [weak self] success, actualPosition in

guard let self else { return }

self.returnRendererRestoreInProgress = false

self.returnRendererReady = success

self.returnActualPosition = actualPosition

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "return renderer-ready=\(success) target=\(String(format: "%.3f", targetPosition)) actual=\(actualPosition.map { String(format: "%.3f", $0) } ?? "unknown")")

if !success { self.failReturnBarrier(reason: "renderer-not-ready") }

}

}


private func pollReturnBarrier(attempt: Int) {

returnPollWorkItem?.cancel(); returnPollWorkItem = nil

guard behavior.presentation == .returning, behavior.exitIntent == .returnToPlayer else { return }

let window = activeKeyWindow()

let windowSize = window?.bounds.size ?? .zero

let hostSize = sourceHostView?.bounds.size ?? .zero

let targetOrientation = AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.pictureInPictureRestoreTargetOrientation

let orientationReady: Bool

if let targetOrientation { orientationReady = targetOrientation.isLandscape ? windowSize.width > windowSize.height : windowSize.height > windowSize.width }

else { orientationReady = windowSize.width > 1 && windowSize.height > 1 }

let hostReady = hostSize.width > 1 && hostSize.height > 1

let gateReleased = !PlayerSurfacePresentationGate.shared.isHolding

let appReady = UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active

let ready = appReady && orientationReady && hostReady && gateReleased && returnRendererReady

if ready {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "return barrier ready renderer=true gateReleased=true window=\(Int(windowSize.width))x\(Int(windowSize.height)) host=\(Int(hostSize.width))x\(Int(hostSize.height)) action=allow-system-expand")

if let completion = pendingRestoreUICompletion {

pendingRestoreUICompletion = nil

completion(true)

} else if manualForegroundReturn, controller?.isPictureInPictureActive == true {

manualForegroundReturn = false

controller?.stopPictureInPicture()

}

return

}

if attempt >= 150 {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "return barrier timeout renderer=\(returnRendererReady) gateReleased=\(gateReleased) appReady=\(appReady) orientationReady=\(orientationReady) action=keep-pip")

failReturnBarrier(reason: "barrier-timeout")

return

}

let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in self?.pollReturnBarrier(attempt: attempt + 1) }

returnPollWorkItem = work

DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.016, execute: work)

}


private func failReturnBarrier(reason: String) {

returnPollWorkItem?.cancel(); returnPollWorkItem = nil

pendingRestoreUICompletion?(false); pendingRestoreUICompletion = nil

manualForegroundReturn = false

returnRendererReady = false

returnRendererRestoreInProgress = false

returnActualPosition = nil

if controller?.isPictureInPictureActive == true {

behavior.presentation = .active

behavior.exitIntent = .none

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "return cancelled reason=\(reason) action=keep-pip")

}

}


private func completeReturnAfterSystemStop() {

guard behavior.exitIntent == .returnToPlayer else { return }

returnPollWorkItem?.cancel(); returnPollWorkItem = nil

pendingRestoreUICompletion = nil

pipeline?.stop()

stagingContext?.pipeline.stop()

sourceHostView?.removeFromSuperview()

sourceHostView = nil

AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.endPictureInPictureRestoreOrientationHold()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "return complete rendererActual=\(returnActualPosition.map { String(format: "%.3f", $0) } ?? "unknown") sourceHost=removed")

reset(reason: "return-complete", preserveOrientationHold: true)

}


private func closePlaybackFromPiP(reason: String) {

guard behavior.exitIntent != .closePlayback else { return }

behavior.exitIntent = .closePlayback

behavior.presentation = .closing

behavior.playback = .stopped

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

cancelSeekTransaction(reason: "close-playback")

pipeline?.setPaused(true)

clock.setPlaying(false)

syncTimebaseToClock()

playbackController?.stop()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "close playback committed reason=\(reason) action=stop-player-session")

}


private func handlePipelineFailure(_ reason: String) {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "pipeline failed reason=\(reason) presentation=\(behavior.presentation.rawValue)")

if behavior.presentation == .active {

behavior.exitIntent = .failureFallback

behavior.presentation = .recovering

if behavior.playback == .playing { applyPlaybackState(.paused, reason: "pipeline-failure") }

controller?.stopPictureInPicture()

} else if behavior.presentation == .preparing || behavior.presentation == .starting {

failAndRecover(reason: reason)

}

}


private func failAndRecover(reason: String) {

behavior.exitIntent = .failureFallback

pendingRestoreUICompletion?(false); pendingRestoreUICompletion = nil

if controller?.isPictureInPictureActive == true { behavior.presentation = .recovering; controller?.stopPictureInPicture(); return }

reset(reason: "failure-\(reason)")

}


private func beginFailureFallbackAfterStop() {

guard behavior.exitIntent == .failureFallback else { return }

let target = playbackController?.snapshot.position ?? clock.position()

restoreInlineRendererWhenForeground(targetPosition: target) { [weak self] _, _ in self?.reset(reason: "failure-fallback") }

}


private func applyPlaybackState(_ requested: PlayerPiPBehaviorState.PlaybackState, reason: String) {

guard requested != .stopped, behavior.playback != .stopped, let playbackController else { return }

behavior.playback = requested

let shouldPlay = requested == .playing

clock.setPlaying(shouldPlay)

if playbackController.playbackControlIsPlaying != shouldPlay { playbackController.togglePlayPause() }

pipeline?.setPaused(shouldPlay ? false : true)

stagingContext?.pipeline.setPaused(true)

syncTimebaseToClock()

controller?.invalidatePlaybackState()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "playback state=\(requested.rawValue) reason=\(reason) clock=\(String(format: "%.3f", clock.position())) seekActive=\(behavior.seek.isActive)")

}


private func syncTimebase(_ timebase: CMTimebase, to position: Double, playing: Bool) {

CMTimebaseSetTime(timebase, time: CMTime(seconds: max(0, position), preferredTimescale: 60000))

CMTimebaseSetRate(timebase, rate: playing ? 1 : 0)

}


private func syncTimebaseToClock() {

guard let timebase = controlTimebase else { return }

syncTimebase(timebase, to: clock.position(), playing: behavior.playback == .playing)

}


private func beginSeek(delta: Double) {

guard let playbackController else { return }

cancelSeekTransaction(reason: "superseded")

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

seekToken &+= 1

let token = seekToken

activeSeekToken = token

activeSeekStartedPosition = playbackController.snapshot.position

playbackController.seek(by: delta)

activeSeekRequestedTarget = playbackController.displayedPosition

behavior.seek = .waitingForLanding(token: token)

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "begin token=\(token) delta=\(String(format: "%.3f", delta)) engineStart=\(String(format: "%.3f", activeSeekStartedPosition ?? 0)) requested=\(activeSeekRequestedTarget.map { String(format: "%.3f", $0) } ?? "unknown") policy=visual-continues")

if seekLandingProvider == nil { scheduleFallbackSeekLanding(token: token, attempt: 0) }

}


private func handleEngineSeekDispatch(_ info: PlayerPiPSeekDispatchInfo) {

guard case .waitingForLanding(let token) = behavior.seek, token == activeSeekToken, let session = activeSession else { return }

if let requested = activeSeekRequestedTarget, abs(requested - info.requestedTarget) > 0.6 {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "dispatch ignored token=\(token) requestedMismatch local=\(String(format: "%.3f", requested)) engine=\(String(format: "%.3f", info.requestedTarget))")

return

}

stagingContext?.pipeline.stop()

let predicted = max(0, info.stagingTarget)

let stagingPipeline = PlayerPiPSamplePipeline(session: session, startPosition: predicted)

let context = SeekStagingContext(token: token, predictedTarget: predicted, pipeline: stagingPipeline)

stagingContext = context

stagingPipeline.onReady = { _ in }

stagingPipeline.onFailure = { [weak self, weak context] reason in DispatchQueue.main.async {

guard let self, let context, self.stagingContext === context else { return }

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "staging failed token=\(context.token) reason=\(reason)")

context.pipeline.stop(); self.stagingContext = nil

} }

stagingPipeline.onSample = { [weak self, weak context] envelope in DispatchQueue.main.async {

guard let self, let context, self.stagingContext === context, context.token == self.activeSeekToken else { return }

context.samples.append(envelope)

if context.samples.count > 90 { context.samples.removeFirst(context.samples.count - 90) }

if envelope.displayable, context.firstDisplayablePTS == nil { context.firstDisplayablePTS = envelope.pts }

if let first = context.firstDisplayablePTS, envelope.displayable, envelope.pts - first >= 0.45, !context.pausedAfterPreroll {

context.pausedAfterPreroll = true

context.pipeline.setPaused(true)

}

if case .waitingForVisualCommit(let waitingToken, let authoritative) = self.behavior.seek, waitingToken == context.token { self.attemptStagedSeekCommit(context: context, authoritative: authoritative) }

} }

context.generation = stagingPipeline.start()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "staging begin token=\(token) seekID=\(info.seekID) requested=\(String(format: "%.3f", info.requestedTarget)) dispatch=\(String(format: "%.3f", info.dispatchTarget)) previous=\(info.previousKeyframe.map { String(format: "%.3f", $0) } ?? "none") predicted=\(String(format: "%.3f", predicted))")

}


private func handleEngineSeekLanding(_ result: SeekResult) {

guard case .waitingForLanding(let token) = behavior.seek, token == activeSeekToken else { return }

seekFallbackWorkItem?.cancel(); seekFallbackWorkItem = nil

let authoritative = max(0, result.actualPosition ?? result.target)

activeSeekLandingHostTime = CACurrentMediaTime()

behavior.seek = .waitingForVisualCommit(token: token, authoritative: authoritative)

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "landing token=\(token) requested=\(String(format: "%.3f", result.target)) actual=\(String(format: "%.3f", authoritative)) completionMs=\(String(format: "%.1f", result.completionLatencyMs)) action=await-ready-visual")

if let context = stagingContext, context.token == token, attemptStagedSeekCommit(context: context, authoritative: authoritative) { return }

beginActivePipelineFallbackSeek(token: token, authoritative: authoritative)

}


@discardableResult

private func attemptStagedSeekCommit(context: SeekStagingContext, authoritative: Double) -> Bool {

guard stagingContext === context, context.token == activeSeekToken, let first = context.firstDisplayablePTS else { return false }

guard abs(first - authoritative) <= 0.45 else {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "staging reject token=\(context.token) predictedFirst=\(String(format: "%.3f", first)) authoritative=\(String(format: "%.3f", authoritative)) delta=\(String(format: "%.3f", first - authoritative))")

context.pipeline.stop(); stagingContext = nil

return false

}

let samples = context.samples

guard samples.contains(where: { $0.displayable }) else { return false }

commitSeekVisual(using: samples, authoritative: authoritative, promotedPipeline: context.pipeline, token: context.token, source: "speculative-staging")

return true

}


private func beginActivePipelineFallbackSeek(token: UInt64, authoritative: Double) {

guard token == activeSeekToken, let pipeline else { return }

fallbackSeekSamples.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)

fallbackSeekGeneration = pipeline.seek(to: authoritative)

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "fallback preroll token=\(token) authoritative=\(String(format: "%.3f", authoritative)) generation=\(fallbackSeekGeneration ?? 0) policy=keep-old-display-queued-until-new-sample-ready")

}


private func commitSeekVisual(using samples: [PlayerPiPSamplePipeline.SampleEnvelope], authoritative: Double, promotedPipeline: PlayerPiPSamplePipeline?, token: UInt64?, source: String) {

guard let token, token == activeSeekToken, let displayLayer else { return }

let validSamples = samples.filter { promotedPipeline != nil ? $0.generation == stagingContext?.generation : $0.generation == fallbackSeekGeneration }

guard !validSamples.isEmpty, validSamples.contains(where: { $0.displayable }) else { return }

let landingHost = activeSeekLandingHostTime ?? CACurrentMediaTime()

let elapsed = behavior.playback == .playing ? max(0, CACurrentMediaTime() - landingHost) : 0

let newClockPosition = authoritative + elapsed


displayLayer.flush()

validSamples.forEach { displayLayer.enqueue($0.buffer) }

clock.reset(position: newClockPosition, playing: behavior.playback == .playing)

syncTimebaseToClock()


if let promotedPipeline {

pipeline?.stop()

pipeline = promotedPipeline

activeGeneration = stagingContext?.generation ?? 1

bindActivePipeline(promotedPipeline)

promotedPipeline.setPaused(behavior.playback != .playing)

stagingContext = nil

} else {

if let fallbackSeekGeneration { activeGeneration = fallbackSeekGeneration }

fallbackSeekGeneration = nil

fallbackSeekSamples.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)

pipeline?.setPaused(behavior.playback != .playing)

}


let settleUntil = CACurrentMediaTime() + 0.12

behavior.seek = .settling(token: token, until: settleUntil)

controller?.invalidatePlaybackState()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "visual commit token=\(token) source=\(source) authoritative=\(String(format: "%.3f", authoritative)) clock=\(String(format: "%.3f", newClockPosition)) bufferedSamples=\(validSamples.count) switch=atomic")

seekSettleWorkItem?.cancel()

let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in

guard let self, case .settling(let currentToken, _) = self.behavior.seek, currentToken == token else { return }

self.behavior.seek = .idle

self.activeSeekToken = nil

self.activeSeekRequestedTarget = nil

self.activeSeekStartedPosition = nil

self.activeSeekLandingHostTime = nil

self.controller?.invalidatePlaybackState()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "settled token=\(token)")

}

seekSettleWorkItem = work

DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.12, execute: work)

}


private func currentAuthoritativeSeekPosition() -> Double? {

if case .waitingForVisualCommit(_, let authoritative) = behavior.seek { return authoritative }

return nil

}


private func scheduleFallbackSeekLanding(token: UInt64, attempt: Int) {

seekFallbackWorkItem?.cancel()

guard token == activeSeekToken, let playbackController, let start = activeSeekStartedPosition else { return }

let current = playbackController.snapshot.position

let moved = abs(current - start) > 0.25 && !playbackController.snapshot.isBuffering

if moved || attempt >= 30 {

let result = SeekResult(requestedAt: CACurrentMediaTime(), target: activeSeekRequestedTarget ?? current, actualPosition: current, bufferHit: false, completionLatencyMs: Double(attempt) * 20, measurement: "PiP fallback snapshot landing")

handleEngineSeekLanding(result)

return

}

let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in self?.scheduleFallbackSeekLanding(token: token, attempt: attempt + 1) }

seekFallbackWorkItem = work

DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.02, execute: work)

}


private func cancelSeekTransaction(reason: String) {

seekFallbackWorkItem?.cancel(); seekFallbackWorkItem = nil

seekSettleWorkItem?.cancel(); seekSettleWorkItem = nil

stagingContext?.pipeline.stop(); stagingContext = nil

fallbackSeekGeneration = nil

fallbackSeekSamples.removeAll(keepingCapacity: false)

activeSeekToken = nil

activeSeekRequestedTarget = nil

activeSeekStartedPosition = nil

activeSeekLandingHostTime = nil

if behavior.seek.isActive { DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "cancel reason=\(reason)") }

behavior.seek = .idle

}


private func reset(reason: String, preserveOrientationHold: Bool = false) {

if !preserveOrientationHold { AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.endPictureInPictureRestoreOrientationHold() }

startTimeout?.cancel(); startTimeout = nil

startPoll?.cancel(); startPoll = nil

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

returnPollWorkItem?.cancel(); returnPollWorkItem = nil

pendingRestoreUICompletion?(false); pendingRestoreUICompletion = nil

pendingForegroundRendererRestore = nil

cancelSeekTransaction(reason: "reset")

possibleObservation = nil

if let seekLandingProvider {

seekLandingProvider.pictureInPictureSeekDispatchHandler = nil

seekLandingProvider.pictureInPictureSeekLandingHandler = nil

}

seekLandingProvider = nil

pipeline?.stop(); pipeline = nil

displayLayer?.flushAndRemoveImage(); displayLayer?.controlTimebase = nil

displayLayer = nil; controlTimebase = nil

sourceHostView?.removeFromSuperview(); sourceHostView = nil

controller?.delegate = nil; controller = nil

activeSession = nil; playbackController = nil; inlineRenderer = nil

activeGeneration = 0

firstVisibleSampleEnqueued = false; sourceSurfaceRevealed = false

inlineRendererSuspended = false; rendererSuspending = false

homeRequested = false

returnRendererReady = false; returnRendererRestoreInProgress = false; returnActualPosition = nil

manualForegroundReturn = false

behavior.reset()

clock = PiPClock()

onActiveChanged?(false)

onPossibleChanged?(AVPictureInPictureController.isPictureInPictureSupported())

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "reset reason=\(reason)")

}


func pictureInPictureControllerWillStartPictureInPicture(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-will-start playback=\(behavior.playback.rawValue)")

}


func pictureInPictureControllerDidStartPictureInPicture(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) {

startTimeout?.cancel(); startTimeout = nil

behavior.presentation = .active

behavior.exitIntent = .none

onActiveChanged?(true)

AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.beginPictureInPictureRestoreOrientationHold()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-started playback=\(behavior.playback.rawValue) orientationHold=true")

requestHomeAfterSystemStart()

}


func pictureInPictureControllerWillStopPictureInPicture(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) {

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

if behavior.exitIntent == .none { closePlaybackFromPiP(reason: "system-close-without-restore") }

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-will-stop exit=\(behavior.exitIntent.rawValue) presentation=\(behavior.presentation.rawValue) playback=\(behavior.playback.rawValue)")

}


func pictureInPictureControllerDidStopPictureInPicture(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-stopped exit=\(behavior.exitIntent.rawValue) presentation=\(behavior.presentation.rawValue) playback=\(behavior.playback.rawValue)")

onActiveChanged?(false)

switch behavior.exitIntent {

case .returnToPlayer:

completeReturnAfterSystemStop()

case .closePlayback:

pipeline?.stop()

stagingContext?.pipeline.stop()

AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.endPictureInPictureRestoreOrientationHold()

onPlaybackClosureRequested?()

reset(reason: "close-playback", preserveOrientationHold: true)

case .failureFallback:

AppOrientationCoordinator.shared.endPictureInPictureRestoreOrientationHold()

beginFailureFallbackAfterStop()

case .detach:

reset(reason: "detach-stopped")

case .none:

closePlaybackFromPiP(reason: "did-stop-without-intent")

onPlaybackClosureRequested?()

reset(reason: "implicit-close")

}

}


func pictureInPictureController(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController, restoreUserInterfaceForPictureInPictureStopWithCompletionHandler completionHandler: @escaping (Bool) -> Void) {

beginReturnToPlayer(reason: "system-restore-control", systemCompletion: completionHandler, manualForeground: false)

}


func pictureInPictureController(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController, failedToStartPictureInPictureWithError error: Error) {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-start failed error=\(error.localizedDescription)")

failAndRecover(reason: "system-start-failed")

}


func pictureInPictureControllerTimeRangeForPlayback(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) -> CMTimeRange {

guard let playbackController else { return .invalid }

return CMTimeRange(start: .zero, duration: CMTime(seconds: max(0.001, playbackController.effectiveDuration), preferredTimescale: 60000))

}


func pictureInPictureControllerIsPlaybackPaused(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) -> Bool { behavior.playback != .playing }


func pictureInPictureController(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController, setPlaying playing: Bool) {

guard behavior.presentation == .active || behavior.presentation == .returning else { return }

guard behavior.exitIntent == .none || behavior.exitIntent == .returnToPlayer else { return }

if playing {

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

applyPlaybackState(.playing, reason: "system-play")

return

}

let now = CACurrentMediaTime()

if behavior.seek.suppressesSystemPause(at: now) {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-pause ignored reason=seek-transaction seek=\(String(describing: behavior.seek))")

return

}

guard behavior.presentation == .active, behavior.exitIntent == .none else {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-pause ignored reason=presentation-transition presentation=\(behavior.presentation.rawValue) exit=\(behavior.exitIntent.rawValue)")

return

}

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel()

let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in

guard let self, self.behavior.presentation == .active, self.behavior.exitIntent == .none, !self.behavior.seek.suppressesSystemPause(at: CACurrentMediaTime()) else { return }

self.pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

self.applyPlaybackState(.paused, reason: "system-pause")

}

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = work

DispatchQueue.main.async(execute: work)

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "system-pause arbitration=next-main-turn")

}


func pictureInPictureController(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController, didTransitionToRenderSize newRenderSize: CMVideoDimensions) {

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPState", "render-size=\(newRenderSize.width)x\(newRenderSize.height) presentation=\(behavior.presentation.rawValue)")

}


func pictureInPictureController(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController, skipByInterval skipInterval: CMTime, completion completionHandler: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) {

let delta = CMTimeGetSeconds(skipInterval)

guard delta.isFinite, behavior.presentation == .active, behavior.exitIntent == .none, behavior.playback != .stopped else { completionHandler(); return }

pendingSystemPauseWorkItem?.cancel(); pendingSystemPauseWorkItem = nil

beginSeek(delta: delta)

completionHandler()

pictureInPictureController.invalidatePlaybackState()

DiagnosticsLogger.shared.playback("PiPSeek", "system completion immediate delta=\(String(format: "%.3f", delta))")

}


func pictureInPictureControllerShouldProhibitBackgroundAudioPlayback(_ pictureInPictureController: AVPictureInPictureController) -> Bool { false }


private func visiblePlaybackSurface() -> UIView? {

guard let window = activeKeyWindow() else { return nil }

if let surface: MPVSurfaceUIView = findVisibleSubview(of: MPVSurfaceUIView.self, in: window) { return surface }

if let surface: KSAVIOSurfaceUIView = findVisibleSubview(of: KSAVIOSurfaceUIView.self, in: window) { return surface }

if let surface: PlayerSurfaceUIView = findVisibleSubview(of: PlayerSurfaceUIView.self, in: window) { return surface }

return nil

}


private func activeKeyWindow() -> UIWindow? {

UIApplication.shared.connectedScenes.compactMap { $0 as? UIWindowScene }.flatMap(\.windows).first(where: { $0.isKeyWindow })

}


private func findVisibleSubview<T: UIView>(of type: T.Type, in root: UIView) -> T? {

if let value = root as? T, !value.isHidden, value.alpha > 0.01, value.window != nil { return value }

for child in root.subviews.reversed() { if let value = findVisibleSubview(of: type, in: child) { return value } }

return nil

}
}

## Assistant

新的状态机核心已经在本地完成第一版，并通过 Swift 语法解析。现在的结构不再有 Build160–164 那些 `restoreRequested / systemStopInProgress / pauseEcho... / keep-live-cover` 交叉补丁，而是统一为：

`PlaybackState + PresentationState + ExitIntent + SeekState`

同时 PiP Seek 已改成**双管线并行预滚**：MPV 在 native seek 真正 dispatch 时把“请求目标 / 实际 dispatch target / 前后关键帧”只读通知给 PiP，PiP 第二条 SampleBuffer pipeline 同时预准备；MPV landing 后优先原子提交已准备好的样本，失败才走 fallback，而且 fallback 也不再提前 flush 旧画面。MPV 的 `absolute+keyframes` 命令本身没有改。

Closing PiP never runs renderer restore.\n- PiP return arms PlayerSurfacePresentationGate release before AVKit expands and only allows system restore after MPV renderer readiness, final orientation geometry, and the black presentation gate are all ready.\n- Orientation remains locked through AVKit didStop, while the black presentation cover is allowed to release earlier after renderer acknowledgement.\n- PiP source host becomes transparent after the first real video sample and no longer attempts to derive an image from compressed CMSampleBuffer data.\n- PiP fast seek uses speculative parallel SampleBuffer preroll from MPV native dispatch telemetry. MPV remains the only authoritative landing timeline.\n- If speculative preroll does not match the MPV landing, fallback seek keeps the old queued PiP video visible until the first authoritative replacement sample is ready; no pre-landing display-layer flush.\n- AVKit seek completion remains immediate after the seek command is accepted; post-seek system pause callbacks are absorbed by SeekState rather than ad-hoc pause flags.\n- MPV PiP renderer resume compares against a moving expected playback position instead of a frozen restore target, avoiding false timeouts while playback continues.\n- MPV native seek remains absolute+keyframes; UnifiedTransport/cache/STRM -> 302 -> 115 client-direct transport and Build161 volume/brightness dedupe remain unchanged.\n- Deployment Target remains iOS 15.0; iOS 17.0 remains supported.\n''')

{"path":"/GitHub/link_6a76205e1a548191a3664f865c5e7a99/create_file","args":{"branch":"fix/pip-state-machine-0.13.98","content":"import Foundation\n\nstruct PlayerPiPBehaviorState: Equatable {\n    enum PlaybackState: String { case playing, paused, stopped }\n    enum PresentationState: String { case idle, preparing, starting, active, returning, closing, recovering }\n    enum ExitIntent: String { case none, returnToPlayer, closePlayback, failureFallback, detach }\n    enum SeekState: Equatable {\n        case idle\n        case waitingForLanding(token: UInt64)\n        case waitingForVisualCommit(token: UInt64, authoritative: Double)\n        case settling(token: UInt64, until: CFTimeInterval)\n\n        var isActive: Bool {\n            switch self {\n            case .idle: return false\n            case .waitingForLanding, .waitingForVisualCommit, .settling: return true\n            }\n        }\n\n        func suppressesSystemPause(at now: CFTimeInterval) -> Bool {\n            switch self {\n            case .idle: return false\n            case .waitingForLanding, .waitingForVisualCommit: return true\n            case .settling(_, let until): return now < until\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    var playback: PlaybackState = .playing\n    var presentation: PresentationState = .idle\n    var exitIntent: ExitIntent = .none\n    var seek: SeekState = .idle\n\n    mutating func beginSession(isPlaying: Bool) {\n        playback = isPlaying ? .playing : .paused\n        presentation = .preparing\n        exitIntent = .none\n        seek = .idle\n    }\n\n    mutating func reset() {\n        playback = .playing\n        presentation = .idle\n        exitIntent = .none\n        seek = .idle\n    }\n}\n","message":"Build165: add unified PiP behavior state","path":"Sources/UI/PlayerPiPBehaviorState.swift","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab"}}

{"path":"/GitHub/link_6a76205e1a548191a3664f865c5e7a99/create_file","args":{"branch":"fix/pip-state-machine-0.13.98","content":"# OnePlayer 0.13.98 Build165\n\n- Replaces the Build160-Build164 PiP callback patchwork with a single PiP behavior state machine: PlaybackState, PresentationState, ExitIntent, and SeekState.\n- PiP close (system X without restore intent) now means close playback: PlayerController.stop() runs during PiP stop, audio stops immediately, Emby Stopped is reported once, and PlayerScreen dismisses when the app returns foreground.\n- System return-to-player and direct PiP close are separate paths. Closing PiP never runs renderer restore.\n- PiP return arms PlayerSurfacePresentationGate release before AVKit expands and only allows system restore after MPV renderer readiness, final orientation geometry, and the black presentation gate are all ready.\n- Orientation remains locked through AVKit didStop, while the black presentation cover is allowed to release earlier after renderer acknowledgement.\n- PiP source host becomes transparent after the first real video sample and no longer attempts to derive an image from compressed CMSampleBuffer data.\n- PiP fast seek uses speculative parallel SampleBuffer preroll from MPV native dispatch telemetry. MPV remains the only authoritative landing timeline.\n- If speculative preroll does not match the MPV landing, fallback seek keeps the old queued PiP video visible until the first authoritative replacement sample is ready; no pre-landing display-layer flush.\n- AVKit seek completion remains immediate after the seek command is accepted; post-seek system pause callbacks are absorbed by SeekState rather than ad-hoc pause flags.\n- MPV PiP renderer resume compares against a moving expected playback position instead of a frozen restore target, avoiding false timeouts while playback continues.\n- MPV native seek remains absolute+keyframes; UnifiedTransport/cache/STRM -> 302 -> 115 client-direct transport and Build161 volume/brightness dedupe remain unchanged.\n- Deployment Target remains iOS 15.0; iOS 17.0 remains supported.\n","message":"Docs: add Build165 PiP state-machine changelog","path":"docs/changelog/CHANGELOG_v0_13_98_build165.md","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab"}}

If the barrier fails, completion(false) keeps PiP instead of exposing a black player.\n- Manual foreground while PiP is active is treated as return-to-player.\n- Failure fallback cannot leave hidden audio playing.\n\nSeek:\n- MPV native absolute+keyframes remains authoritative and unchanged.\n- A non-invasive MPV dispatch callback exposes requested/dispatch/keyframe telemetry to PiP.\n- A second SampleBuffer pipeline speculatively prerolls in parallel while the currently visible PiP pipeline continues playing.\n- Nothing speculative is displayed before MPV authoritative landing.\n- If staging matches the landing, buffered samples are atomically committed and the staging pipeline becomes active.\n- Otherwise fallback seeks the active PiP pipeline but keeps old queued video visible until replacement samples are ready.\n- AVKit completion remains immediate.\n\nReturn black-screen fix:\n- preparePictureInPictureRestoreDestination now refreshes PlayerSurfacePresentationGate while orientation hold remains active, so the black presentation cover may release after MPV renderer acknowledgement before AVKit expands.\n- MPV fresh-frame matching uses a moving expected target while playback advances.\n\nFrozen:\n- UnifiedTransport/cache/STRM -> 302 -> 115 client-direct transport unchanged.\n- Build161 volume/brightness dedupe unchanged.\n- Deployment Target remains iOS 15.0; iOS 17.0 remains the required real-device target.\n\nDraft pending Xcode 16.4 Release CI and real-device validation.","draft":true,"head_branch":"fix/pip-state-machine-0.13.98","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab","title":"Build165: unified PiP state machine and speculative seek handoff"}}

## Assistant

已经开始，而且这次不是继续给 Build164 打补丁，而是在做 **Build165 / OnePlayer 0.13.98 的 PiP 状态机重构**。

目前正式开发分支是：

```text
fix/pip-state-machine-0.13.98
PR #222
当前正式源码 head：
e719fce7f32eaa468034eb656129082ca59392bb
```

这轮已经完成的核心重构包括：

- PiP 改成统一的 `PlaybackState / PresentationState / ExitIntent / SeekState`，删除 Build160～164 那套相互交叉的 `restoreRequested / pause echo / systemStop / live cover` 补丁逻辑。
- **PiP 的 X 正式定义为“结束本次播放”**：立即 `PlayerController.stop()`，MPV 音频停止、UnifiedTransport 会话停止、Emby `Stopped` 由现有 PlayerController 路径只上报一次；用户之后手动回 App 时关闭 PlayerScreen，不再继续播放。
- “返回播放器”和“关闭 PiP”彻底分成两个 ExitIntent，X 不再执行 renderer restore。
- 找到了 Build164 返回黑屏真正的底层原因：`PlayerSurfacePresentationGate` 的黑色 cover 没有被 release。Build165 在 AVKit 开始放大之前就 arm renderer acknowledgement，必须满足 **MPV renderer ready + 最终横屏 geometry + 黑色 presentation gate 已释放**，才允许系统 restore。
- 如果上述 return barrier 失败，直接 `completion(false)`，**宁可继续留在 PiP，也不允许强行返回一个黑播放器**。
- Return 流程已经做成幂等，手动 foreground 和 AVKit `restoreUserInterface` 同时发生时不会启动两次 renderer restore。
- MPV fresh-frame 不再拿一个静止的旧 target 做比较。播放仍在继续时使用随 host time 前进的 expected position，解决之前“播放器其实正常前进，却因为差 1 秒被误判恢复失败”的问题。
- PiP Seek 改成**双 persistent pipeline 并行架构**。一条负责当前画面，一条常驻备用；MPV native seek dispatch 时备用 pipeline 同时进行 speculative preroll，MPV actual landing 后才允许原子提交。
- 两条 pipeline 会交换 active/standby 身份，下一次 Seek 继续复用现成 demux。没有每次 Seek 重新 open FFmpeg，这一点我在源码复核时专门纠正了。
- speculative pipeline **只能提前准备，不能提前决定最终时间轴**。最终显示位置仍严格服从 MPV actual landing。
- 如果 speculative 预测没命中，不再提前 `flush()` 当前 PiP 画面；旧画面继续运动，直到 authoritative replacement sample 已经准备好才执行一次原子切换。
- MPV 原生 Seek 本身仍是原来的 **`absolute+keyframes`**，没有恢复 `absolute+exact`，也没有修改 Build145 那条正式快进路径。
- Seek 期间也不再无限吞真实暂停：只有 Seek 开始最前面的极短系统过渡窗口以及视觉 commit 后的 AVKit echo 窗会抑制假的 `setPlaying(false)`；遇到 500～700ms 长尾时，用户中途真正点暂停仍然可以生效。
- Build161 已验证有效的音量 1% 去重完全没动。
- UnifiedTransport、缓存、STRM → 302 → 115/CDN 客户端直连完全没动。
- Deployment Target 保持 **iOS 15.0**。

PR #222 的 diff 已审计，目前只涉及 10 个预期的 PiP/播放器协调文件，没有传输和缓存代码。

第一轮 Xcode 16.4 Release 已经完整编译成功，但那是我做第二轮架构复核之前的源码，因此我**没有拿它作为 Build165 最终 IPA**。

```text
persistent 双 PiP pipeline
Return 幂等
Seek 长尾期间真实 Pause 语义
```

## Assistant

我已经把这轮五个问题的根因分开了，尤其缓存问题已经从源码确认，不只是现象：

- Build165 **并没有真的创建 Wi-Fi/蜂窝两套目录**；稳定 cache key 本身不含网络类型。
- 但当前滚动缓存的**保留窗口和总量淘汰上限直接跟当前网络的 preloadWindow 绑定**。所以从 Wi-Fi 4GB 切到蜂窝 512MB 后，统一 store 会按 512MB 的窗口主动 `evictCachedBytes`，等价于把原来 Wi-Fi 已缓存的大量 Range 删除掉；如果蜂窝设置为“不缓存”，当前配置甚至会把 persistent cache 逻辑关闭。这就是你看到两套缓冲位置的根因。
- 正确模型应该是：**只有一个持久 Range 池；Wi-Fi/蜂窝只决定“当前网络还允许向前预取多少”，绝不能决定已缓存 Range 的身份或淘汰范围。**

PiP 也有三条日志证据：进入桌面前 `gpu-next → null` 会触发 MPV 内部一次无主 Seek/视频重配置，正好对应短暂无声；Seek 的备用 pipeline 实际 2–21ms 就准备好了，但我们仍等 MPV 111–180ms landing 才显示，所以还有顿感；返回时 presentation 黑盖层在 MPV fresh-frame **之前约 0.58 秒就被 release**，所以“老一帧/黑屏”仍然有窗口。

我现在直接做 Build166，把这五项按这套模型一起收口，不再改传输字节路径。

Orientation hold remains independent and lasts through AVKit stop.\n- PiP close dismissal now also listens for UIApplication.didBecomeActive so a stopped PiP session cannot leave a black PlayerScreen when SwiftUI scenePhase misses the transition.\n- PiP entry moves MPV gpu-next -> null suspension before the Home transition and waits for playback-clock continuity before requesting Home, reducing the desktop-visible audio interruption window while preserving the Build159 MoltenVK safety rule.\n- MPV native seek remains absolute+keyframes. UnifiedTransport client-direct STRM -> 302 -> 115 byte flow, Build161 volume dedupe, and iOS 15.0 Deployment Target remain unchanged.\n","message":"Docs: add Build166 shared-cache and PiP handoff changelog","path":"docs/changelog/CHANGELOG_v0_13_99_build166.md","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab"}}

## Assistant

可以，Build166 已经完成并通过正式 Release CI。这一轮不只是继续修 PiP，我把你指出的**缓存池语义错误也按正确架构改了**。

先确认缓存问题：之前并不是磁盘上真的有 Wi-Fi/蜂窝两个目录，而是更隐蔽的设计错误——**同一个 sparse Range store 被“当前网络的缓存上限”拿去做淘汰窗口**。例如 Wi-Fi 已经缓存约 3.6GB，切到蜂窝 512MB 后，代码会按蜂窝窗口主动删除大量原有 Range，所以行为上就像重新换了一套缓存。你指出的语义是正确的。

Build166 现在固定为：

```text
同一媒体

↓
一个 Stable Cache Key

↓
一个 Sparse File

↓
一个 ranges.json / Range Map

↓
Wi-Fi 与蜂窝共同读取
```

而网络设置现在只负责：

```text
Wi-Fi 预加载上限
蜂窝网络预加载上限
```

不再决定已经缓存的数据能不能存在。

例如：

```text
Wi-Fi 预加载上限 = 4 GB
蜂窝预加载上限 = 512 MB

已经通过 Wi-Fi 缓存：
[0 -------- 3.6 GB]
```

切蜂窝以后仍然是：

```text
共享缓存池：
[0 -------- 3.6 GB]   ← 原样保留

蜂窝只限制：
当前位置以后主动预取多少
```

不会为了 512MB 蜂窝设置把之前 3.6GB Range 打洞删除。

而且如果：

```text
蜂窝 = 不预加载
Wi-Fi = 4 GB
```

现在含义是：

> 蜂窝网络不主动往前预加载，但已有缓存仍然存在，播放实际缺少的数据仍可按需读取。

不再像之前那样因为蜂窝设置为 0 就把 persistent cache 判定关闭甚至清理。

设置页文字也改了：

```text
Wi-Fi 视频缓存
→ Wi-Fi 预加载上限

蜂窝网络视频缓存
→ 蜂窝网络预加载上限

不缓存
→ 不预加载
```

缓存池本身只有一份。

### PiP Seek 这次也进一步改了

Build165 日志非常有价值。

备用 persistent pipeline 实际经常只需要：

```text
2 ~ 21ms
```

就已经准备好了目标关键帧。

但是 Build165 明明已经有目标画面，却还傻等：

```text
MPV authoritative landing
≈ 111 ~ 180ms
```

以后才显示它。

所以之前所谓“双 pipeline”实际上没有真正把并行准备的优势利用起来。

Build166 改成：

```text
点击 +10

│

├─ MPV native absolute+keyframes

│        └─ 继续决定最终权威落点

│

└─ standby persistent pipeline

└─ 通常 2~21ms 准备预测关键帧

↓

预测可信时立即显示

↓

MPV 100~180ms 后 landing

↓

验证实际位置
```

如果：

```text
预测帧 ≈ MPV actual landing
误差 <= 0.45s
```

就不再做第二次画面 flush，只重新校准时钟。

如果预测错误：

```text
预测位置

≠
MPV actual landing
```

才执行 authoritative correction。

这意味着 MPV 仍然是**最终权威时间轴**，但 PiP 不再为了等 MPV 100 多毫秒才第一次给用户视觉响应。

这应该比 Build165 更接近主播放器的即时感。

不过这一项我特别注明：它属于新的真机行为，需要你测试**短暂音视频关系**。因为视频可能在约 10ms 就跳到预测目标，而 MPV 音频约 100ms 后才完成 landing。日志里预测非常准，但实际视觉/听感是否更自然，必须以你的真机结果为准。

### PiP 返回播放器的黑屏/老一帧

Build165 日志把时序问题抓得很清楚：

```text
PlayerPresentation 黑盖 release
27.705

MPV fresh-frame ready
28.289
```

我们居然提前了约：

**584ms**

撤掉播放器恢复遮罩。

这意味着 MPV 真正的新画面还没准备好时，底下的 renderer 就已经暴露，所以会看到：

- 老一帧；
- 黑帧；
- 或两者闪一下。

Build166 顺序改成：

```text
开始返回播放器
↓
保持 presentation cover
↓
恢复 gpu-next
↓
等待 MPV fresh-frame
↓
fresh-frame 确认成功
↓
才 arm PlayerSurfacePresentationGate release
↓
renderer layout acknowledgment
↓
撤掉 cover
↓
允许 AVKit 完成返回
```

方向锁和黑盖释放现在也是两个不同概念：

```text
Orientation Hold
持续到 AVKit didStop

Presentation Cover
MPV fresh-frame 后即可释放
```

不再因为方向 geometry 已经正确，就提前把视频遮罩一起撤掉。

### PiP 刚出桌面的短暂无声

这一项日志显示与：

```text
MPV vo:
gpu-next → null
```

高度相关。

切 VO 后还出现了一次无主 MPV Seek event 和一连串 HEVC decoder reconfiguration/error，期间播放时钟明显停滞。

但这里不能简单粗暴地删除 `vo=null`，因为之前 Build159 真机已经验证过：

```text
gpu-next 在后台继续工作
→ MoltenVK
→ VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST
```

所以 Build166 保留这个安全约束，但改变时序。

以前：

```text
AVKit PiP didStart
↓
Home
↓
PiP 已经出现在桌面
↓
App background
↓
这时才 gpu-next → null
↓
用户在桌面看到/听到重配置卡顿
```

现在：

```text
AVKit PiP didStart
↓
仍停留在 OnePlayer 前台
↓
先 gpu-next → null
↓
等待 MPV time-pos 再次真正向前 ≥ 60ms
↓
确认 playback clock 已恢复
↓
才请求 Home
↓
桌面 PiP 出现
```

目标是把这段不可避免的 renderer 重配置**挡在离开 App 之前完成**，而不是让桌面 PiP 已经出现后才突然没声。

如果 suspend 失败，不再硬切 Home，而是取消 PiP/failure fallback，避免带着 gpu-next 进后台。

只要 PiP X 已经结束播放：

```text
↓
强制 finalizePiPClosedPlaybackDismissal()
↓
恢复普通方向
↓
关闭 PlayerScreen
↓
回到原页面
```

不能再留一个停止状态的黑播放器。

你这次的判断是对的，我已经把 **Build166 日志 + 17.4 秒录屏**逐段对齐了。现在可以确认：继续直接改 PiP 状态机还不合适，已经暴露出几个更底层的问题。**我先不做 Build167。**

### 1. PiP 到桌面后要等一会才有声：不是 AVKit 慢，是 `vo=null` 让 MPV 自己进入了一次重新 Seek / Buffer

录屏音轨里能直接测到一段约 **3 秒的真正静音**，大约在录屏 `2.6s → 5.6s`。

对应日志非常清楚：

```text
11:41:59.855
vo suspend ready=true
gpu-next → null

11:42:00.545
MPVSeekEvent id=none event=seek

11:42:00.546
buffering=true

11:42:00.579
我们却判断：
vo suspend continuity ready=true

11:42:00.582
马上 request Home

11:42:03.181
playback-restart-without-pending
buffering=false
```

所以 Build166 新加的这个判断：

> `time-pos` 前进 60ms 就认为 MPV 已经恢复

是错的。

它在 MPV **已经进入 buffering=true** 的情况下仍然返回成功，然后把 App 送回桌面。真正播放恢复是在约 **2.6 秒以后**。

而且期间日志有大量 HEVC：

```text
Could not find ref with POC...
Error constructing the frame RPS
Skipping invalid undecodable NALU...
```

这说明 `gpu-next → null` 对当前媒体并不是单纯“关闭视频输出”，而是在 MPV 内部引发了视频链重新配置，甚至产生了一次没有业务 Seek ID 的 Seek。

所以这里不能再用：

```text
多等 100ms
多等 500ms
检查 time-pos
```

这种办法。

因为真正的问题是：

> **PiP 的声音还依赖 MPV，但我们为了后台安全又必须重构 MPV 的视频 VO，而 VO 重构会短暂停住整个 MPV 播放时钟。**

之前又已经证明 `gpu-next` 直接留在后台会导致 MoltenVK `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST`。

因此这一项需要先单独验证一种**不扰动 MPV 音频时钟的 renderer suspend 方法**；如果做不到，才需要考虑让 PiP 音频也脱离 MPV。不能继续围绕 `vo=null` 加等待。

### 2. 返回播放器黑屏，但下拉控制中心马上恢复：根因已经基本锁死

这个录屏非常关键。

录屏大约：

```text
11.4s~11.6s
短暂能看到真实视频

随后
黑屏

一直到约 16.5s
你开始下拉控制中心
→ 视频突然重新出现
```

这几乎可以排除：

- 视频没有数据；
- MPV 没在播放；
- 网络卡死；
- 115 缓冲问题。

日志与它完全吻合。

返回时我们做了：

```text
11:42:07.716
return target = 2671.781
```

但是 MPV 真正的位置只有：

```text
11:42:08.177
actual = 2669.247
```

一开始就差了：

**2.534 秒。**

然后我们的 fresh-frame 检查还把 target 按真实时间不断往前推：

```text
expected 2672.242
expected 2672.553
expected 2673.194
...
```

而 MPV 实际仍然：

```text
2669.247
2669.267
2669.500
...
```

最后差到约：

```text
-4 秒
```

所以永远无法通过：

```text
abs(delta) <= 0.75
```

最终：

```text
11:42:09.953
fresh-frame handoff success=false
reason=fresh-frame-timeout
```

这里有一个非常重要的设计错误：

> **我们口口声声说 MPV 是权威时间轴，但返回播放器时，却拿 PiP 自己的 clock 去要求 MPV 对齐。**

这是反的。

返回播放器应该是：

```text
MPV 当前真实位置 = authority
PiP 视觉 replica 向 MPV 收敛
```

而不是：

```text
PiP clock = authority
要求 MPV 追 PiP
```

### 3. 更严重的是：renderer 还没 ready，AVKit 已经停止 PiP，但我们仍然直接结束了 return

日志：

```text
11:42:08.703
system-will-stop
renderer 还没 ready

11:42:09.253
system-stopped

11:42:09.253

sourceHost=removed
reset
```

此时 fresh-frame 其实还在后台轮询，而且一直失败到：

```text
11:42:09.953
fresh-frame-timeout
```

也就是说状态机现在存在一个明显矛盾：

```text
renderer 没准备好
↓
AVKit didStop
↓
我们却直接认为 return complete
↓
撤掉 PiP source
↓
留下一个尚未被真正唤醒的 MPV surface
```

这就是黑屏出现的位置。

### 4. 为什么下拉控制中心就恢复？

这次证据几乎是“实锤”。

你下拉控制中心之后：

```text
11:42:13.031
App inactive
```

再回 active：

```text
11:42:13.666
PlayerPresentation refresh
reason=foreground-active

11:42:13.666
MPVSurface foreground presentation replay

11:42:13.721
PlayerPresentation release
```

然后画面就出现了。

所以控制中心实际上无意中帮我们执行了一个缺失步骤：

> **重新 replay / layout / kick MPV Surface。**

因此当前黑屏不是播放器没有视频帧，而是：

```text
PiP restore
↓
gpu-next 已回来
↓
但 MPV Metal surface 没有走完整的 foreground presentation replay
↓
停在黑色 presentation gate / 未重新呈现状态
```

控制中心制造了一次：

```text
inactive → active
```

恰好把这个流程补上，于是画面立即出来。

下一轮正确修法不是“再加 0.5 秒延时”，而应该把：

```text
MPVSurface foreground presentation replay
RendererLayout forceRefresh
presentation gate acknowledgement
```

变成 **PiP didStop / renderer restore 的正式步骤**，不能依赖一次额外的 scene lifecycle。

### 5. 我还发现了一个隐藏得更严重的 PiP 状态 bug

这次日志里后面又进入了一次 PiP。

从：

```text
11:42:22.511
```

到：

```text
11:42:25.178
```

一共出现了 **163 次**：

```text
Failed acquiring swapchain image:
VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST
```

为什么？

源码里现在有：

```swift
if pictureInPictureRendererSuspended {

completion(true)

return
}
```

而返回播放器失败时：

```swift
if success {

pictureInPictureRendererSuspended = false
}
```

也就是说：

```text
之前：
vo=null
rendererSuspended=true

返回：
已经把 vo 实际切回 gpu-next

但 fresh-frame timeout
success=false

于是：
rendererSuspended 仍然 = true
```

产生了一个不可能状态：

```text
逻辑状态：
rendererSuspended = true

MPV 实际状态：
currentVO = gpu-next
```

下一次进入 PiP：

```text
suspendInlineRenderer...
↓
发现 rendererSuspended=true
↓
直接返回 success
↓
根本没有再次执行 vo=null
```

于是真正的 `gpu-next` 被带入后台。

后面就是你日志里的：

**163 次 `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST`。**

这很可能也是 PiP 多次进出以后越来越不稳定、返回黑屏概率性的一个重要来源。

这个必须在所有视觉优化之前修掉。

## 所以下一轮我不准备再“修三个现象”

我认为应该先解决三个基础问题，而且顺序不能乱：

1. **修正 MPV PiP renderer 状态一致性**：`rendererSuspended` 必须根据真实 `current-vo` 校验，任何 resume timeout 都不能留下 `flag=true / vo=gpu-next` 这种矛盾状态；先彻底消灭 `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST` 回归。
2. **重新设计 return handoff**：MPV 当前位置重新成为唯一 authority；`didStop` 不能在 renderer 未 ready 时直接 `return complete`；显式执行一次 MPVSurface renderer replay/layout acknowledgement，不再依赖控制中心“救活”。
3. **重新研究 PiP entry 的音频切换**：`vo=null` 当前会触发无主 Seek + buffering，因此不能再靠 time-pos continuity 判断。需要先找一个“不打断 MPV audio”的 renderer suspend 方法；如果 MPV 做不到，再考虑是否需要 PiP 自己承接音频。

## Assistant

明白，这个语义就固定下来，后面不再改解释。

**关闭 PiP 的 X = 等价于在播放界面点一次“暂停”，然后让 App 留在后台并由 iOS 正常挂起。**

具体行为应该是：

- PiP 正在播放时点 **X**：

- `PlayerController` 执行 **pause**，不是 `stop`

- MPV 音频立即停止

- 视频位置保持在关闭 PiP 时的位置

- UnifiedTransport 设置为非播放推进状态，不继续主动预加载

- Emby 上报 **Pause/Progress**，**不能上报 Stopped**

- 不销毁 MPV

- 不销毁当前播放 session

- 不退出 `PlayerScreen`

- 不自动回详情页

- PiP 结束后 App 继续留在后台；没有音频/后台任务后，由 **iOS 自己进入 suspended 状态**

这里需要说明一点：iOS 没有普通公开 API 让 App 主动调用“把自己挂起”。正确实现就是**停止所有需要后台持续运行的活动，然后让系统自然 suspend App**。

之后你手动重新打开 OnePlayer：

```text
仍然回到原来的播放器页面
↓
保持暂停状态
↓
位置仍然是关闭 PiP 时的位置
↓
恢复 MPV inline renderer
↓
显示该位置画面
↓
用户自己点播放才继续
```

不能出现：

```text
X
→ PlayerController.stop()
→ Emby Stopped
→ dismiss PlayerScreen
→ 回详情页
```

这一整条 Build165/166 的逻辑都应该删除。

而 **PiP 的“返回播放器”按钮**是另一套完全不同的语义：

```text
返回播放器
→ 播放状态保持不变
→ 如果原来正在播放就继续播放
→ 恢复 MPV renderer
→ 返回 PlayerScreen
```

所以最终两条路径固定为：

| 操作 | 播放状态 | PlayerScreen | Emby |
|---|---|---|---|
| PiP「返回播放器」 | 保持原状态 | 返回播放器 | 继续当前 session |
| PiP「X」 | **暂停** | 保留，App 在后台 | **Pause，不 Stopped** |
| 手动重新打开 App | 仍暂停 | 显示原播放器 | session 继续存在 |
| 播放器左上角关闭 | Stop | 退出播放器 | **Stopped** |

下一轮我会把当前状态机里的：

`ExitIntent.closePlayback`

重新定义成类似：

`ExitIntent.closePiPAndPause`

并把 **stop / dismiss / Emby Stopped** 从 PiP X 路径彻底移除。

同时之前查到的另外两个底层问题——**MPV renderer suspended 状态与真实 `current-vo` 不一致**、以及**返回播放器需要靠控制中心触发 surface replay 才恢复画面**——仍然要先一起梳理清楚，再做下一版，不会只改 X 的语义就马上出包。

{"path":"/GitHub/link_6a76205e1a548191a3664f865c5e7a99/create_file","args":{"branch":"fix/pip-renderer-handoff-0.14.0","content":"# OnePlayer 0.14.0 Build167\n\n- PiP seek behavior is frozen from Build166 for this round; no further fast-seek tuning is included.\n- PiP X now means the same as pressing Pause in the player and then leaving the app in the background: playback becomes paused, UnifiedTransport playback advancement stops, Emby receives Pause/Progress rather than Stopped, PlayerScreen remains alive, and iOS may naturally suspend the app.\n- Returning to the app after PiP X restores the inline video renderer while remaining paused at the preserved playback position; the player is not dismissed to the detail page.\n- MPV PiP background suspension no longer switches `vo` between `gpu-next` and `null`. Build167 disables only the selected video track with `vid=no`, preserving the MPV audio path while PiP video is supplied by the SampleBuffer pipeline.\n- The selected MPV video track ID is captured before PiP suspension and restored on foreground return. Suspension state is reconciled from the real `vid` property on every suspend/resume completion, eliminating stale logical state such as \u201csuspended=true while gpu-next is actually active\u201d.\n- PiP return uses the current MPV snapshot position as the authoritative restore target instead of the PiP replica clock.\n- PlayerSurfacePresentationGate now separates \u201csurface replay\u201d from \u201ccover release\u201d. Final-orientation replay is triggered before MPV fresh-frame waiting, while the black presentation cover remains held; the cover is armed for release only after MPV reports a fresh restored video frame.\n- If AVKit `didStop` arrives before renderer readiness, the PiP SampleBuffer source host remains in place as the visual bridge. It is removed only after MPV renderer readiness and presentation-gate release are both confirmed.\n- Manual foreground restore after PiP X uses the same replay/fresh-frame handshake but keeps playback paused.\n- Build166 shared Wi-Fi/cellular sparse Range cache semantics remain unchanged: one cache pool, network-specific preload limits only.\n- MPV native seek remains `absolute+keyframes`; UnifiedTransport STRM -> 302 -> 115 client-direct byte flow remains unchanged.\n- Deployment Target remains iOS 15.0; iOS 17.0 remains supported.\n","message":"Docs: add Build167 PiP renderer handoff changelog","path":"docs/changelog/CHANGELOG_v0_14_0_build167.md","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab"}}

MPV continues playing, but the inline Metal surface is not explicitly replayed/kicked before handoff; pulling Control Center causes inactive -> active, which triggers the missing foreground surface replay and immediately restores video.\n- Build166 can leave logical rendererSuspended=true while the actual MPV vo is already gpu-next after a failed fresh-frame timeout, causing later PiP entries to skip real suspension and produce VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST.\n- PiP X semantics were too aggressive: it stopped the PlayerController and dismissed PlayerScreen, while desired behavior is equivalent to Pause and background app suspension.\n\nBuild167 behavior:\n- PiP X = pauseAndSuspend: same user-visible playback state as pressing Pause in PlayerScreen. No PlayerController.stop(), no Emby Stopped, no PlayerScreen dismissal. PiP pipelines stop after system PiP closes; playback session and paused position remain alive. iOS can naturally suspend the app.\n- When user later reopens the app, inline video is restored while playback remains paused.\n- PiP return remains separate and preserves playing/paused state.\n- MPV PiP background mode no longer changes vo. It captures the selected video track ID and sets vid=no while PiP SampleBuffer supplies video; audio remains on MPV. Return restores the original vid.\n- Suspension state is reconciled from the real MPV vid property on every suspend/resume completion, not from a stale Boolean.\n- PlayerSurfacePresentationGate now has separate replay and armRelease phases. Final-orientation replay occurs while the black cover remains held; only a fresh MPV video frame can arm release.\n- Return restore target is the current MPV snapshot, not the PiP replica clock.\n- AVKit didStop does not imply renderer handoff completion. If didStop arrives early, the inline PiP source host remains as a visual bridge until MPV renderer readiness + presentation release are both confirmed.\n- Paused foreground restore after PiP X uses the same surface replay/fresh-frame handshake.\n\nFrozen:\n- Build166 PiP fast-seek implementation is unchanged in this round.\n- Build166 shared Wi-Fi/cellular cache pool semantics are unchanged.\n- MPV native seek remains absolute+keyframes.\n- UnifiedTransport STRM -> 302 -> 115/CDN client-direct byte flow is unchanged.\n- Deployment Target remains iOS 15.0; iOS 17.0 remains the required real-device target.\n\nDraft pending Xcode 16.4 Release CI and real-device validation.","draft":true,"head_branch":"fix/pip-renderer-handoff-0.14.0","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab","title":"Build167: PiP pause-suspend semantics and renderer handoff"}}

### 这次最核心的变化

**PiP 的 X 语义已经按你最后确认的规则重做：**

```text
PiP 播放中点 X
↓
等价于播放器点击暂停
↓
PlayerController.pause
↓
UnifiedTransport playbackAdvancing=false
↓
Emby Pause / Progress
↓
不发送 Stopped
↓
不销毁 MPV
↓
不退出 PlayerScreen
↓
App 留在后台，由 iOS 自然挂起
```

之后你手动重新打开 OnePlayer：

```text
仍是原播放器页面
↓
仍保持暂停
↓
位置保持在关闭 PiP 时
↓
恢复视频画面
↓
只有你自己按播放才继续
```

Build165/166 那套：

```text
PiP X
→ PlayerController.stop()
→ 自动退出播放器
→ 回详情页
```

已经完全删除。

---

**PiP 进入桌面的音频问题，这次没有再围着 `vo=null` 加等待。**

Build166 日志已经证明：

```text
gpu-next → null
```

会触发 MPV 视频重配置、无主 Seek、buffering，实际可以停两三秒。

Build167 已经完全取消 PiP 生命周期里的：

```text
vo=gpu-next
↕
vo=null
```

现在 `vo` 始终保持：

```text
gpu-next
```

进入 PiP 后只执行：

```text
记录当前视频轨 ID
↓
vid=no
```

即**只关闭 MPV 视频轨，音频轨继续运行**，PiP 视频继续由 SampleBuffer pipeline 提供。

mpv 官方文档本身也把 `vid=no` 定义为关闭视频播放，并指出对于不需要视频的情况通常更适合直接禁用视频，而不是使用 null VO。

返回时再恢复刚才记录的真实视频轨 ID。

更重要的是，Build167 不再相信：

```text
rendererSuspended = true
```

这种布尔值就是事实。

每次 suspend / resume 后都会重新读取：

```text
MPV vid
current-vo
```

重新校准状态。

因此 Build166 出现的这种矛盾：

```text
逻辑：
rendererSuspended=true

实际：
currentVO=gpu-next
```

理论上已经从设计上消除了。

这也是为了消除你日志里后续那 **163 次 `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST`** 的来源。

---

**返回播放器黑屏则重新做了真正的 renderer handoff。**

你之前下拉控制中心一下画面就恢复，已经证明缺的是：

```text
MPVSurface foreground presentation replay
```

而不是视频数据。

Build167 把 Presentation Gate 拆成两个完全独立动作：

```text
replay
```

和：

```text
armRelease
```

返回播放器现在顺序变成：

```text
App foreground
↓
恢复最终横屏 geometry
↓
黑色 presentation cover 继续保持
↓
主动触发 MPVSurface replay
↓
RendererLayout force refresh
↓
恢复 MPV 原视频轨
↓
等待真正 fresh video frame
↓
确认 viewport / position
↓
才 armRelease
↓
RendererLayout acknowledgement
↓
撤黑盖
↓
完成 AVKit → MPV handoff
```

所以不会再像 Build166：

```text
先等 fresh-frame
↑
但 Surface 根本没有 replay
```

形成循环依赖。

---

还有一个很重要的改变：

### `AVKit didStop` 不再等于“播放器恢复完成”

之前：

```text
AVKit didStop
↓
立即删除 SampleBuffer host
↓
renderer 其实还没 ready
↓
黑屏
```

Build167 改成：

```text
AVKit didStop
↓
renderer ready?
```

如果没有：

```text
NO
↓
继续保留 PlayerPiPSourceHostView
↓
继续显示 SampleBuffer 视频作为视觉桥
↓
继续恢复 MPV
```

只有同时满足：

```text
MPV renderer ready
+
presentation gate released
```

以后才：

```text
删除 SampleBuffer host
↓
正式交给 MPV
```

这正是针对你“实际上还在播放，但画面黑；拉一下控制中心才出现”的问题。

---

### 返回播放器的时间轴也修正了

之前我们嘴上说 MPV 是 authority，但 return target 用的是：

```text
PiP clock
```

这就是导致日志出现：

```text
PiP target ≈ 2671.781
MPV actual ≈ 2669.247

一开始就差约 2.5 秒
```

的原因。

现在返回目标直接取：

```text
PlayerController.snapshot.position
```

即：

```text
MPV current position
```

日志也会明确出现：

```text
authority=mpv-snapshot
```

PiP replica 不再反过来要求 MPV 追它。

## Assistant

证据已经对齐了，这次两个细节问题都能精确定位，不需要再猜：

- **返回播放器那“一帧 PiP 黑底/线条残留”**：日志里 MPV 黑盖在 `12:39:09.059` 已释放，但 `sourceHost` 到 `12:39:09.076` 才移除，正好相差约 **17ms≈一帧**。录屏里那一帧残留也正好出现在系统放大结束、MPV 已经出来的交界处。也就是说桥接层撤晚了一帧。
- **X 关闭 PiP 后回 App 要等几秒**：第一次恢复其实位置、viewport 都已经正确，但因为播放是暂停状态，没有新的 `playback-restart` / `video-pts`，fresh-frame 判定一直拒绝，硬等到 **2.5 秒 timeout**；第二次 retry 把“已启用的视频轨”当作 fresh signal 后，约 **20ms** 就成功了。这个等待是我们判定条件错了，不是 MPV 真要几秒出图。

这两个都属于 Build167 的小边界问题。我会做 Build168，只修这两项；**PiP Seek 完全冻结**，你这次那次超长延迟先留日志，后面单独处理。

## Assistant

这次我先把录屏和日志完整对齐后才动代码，两个问题都找到了非常明确的时序原因，并已经完成 **Build168 / OnePlayer 0.14.1**。

### 1. PiP 返回播放器那一帧黑底/线条残留

录屏里确实能看到，不是错觉。

Build167 日志里时序正好是：

```text
12:39:09.059
PlayerPresentation release
→ MPV 黑色保护层已经撤掉

12:39:09.076
return complete
→ sourceHost 才 remove
```

中间大约：

**17ms**

刚好接近一帧。

也就是说 Build167 的顺序实际上是：

```text
MPV 已准备好
↓
先露出播放器
↓
PiP SampleBuffer bridge 仍然压在最上面一帧
↓
下一帧才删除
```

而录屏中出现的那个 PiP 线条图标，也与 `PlayerPiPSourceHostView` 里原来我们自己放的：

```swift
UIImage(systemName: "pip")
```

完全一致。

Build168 做了两层处理：

```text
MPV fresh frame ready
↓
黑色 PlayerPresentation cover 仍然保持
↓
先把 sourceHost alpha=0
↓
再 arm presentation release
↓
MPV renderer acknowledgement
↓
最后撤黑盖
```

所以理论上已经不存在：

```text
黑盖撤了
但 PiP sourceHost 还残留一帧
```

这个窗口。

另外我把 `PlayerPiPSourceHostView` 里的 **PiP 占位图标彻底删除了**。

现在 host：

- 初始 `alpha=0`
- 等真实 SampleBuffer 到达才显示
- 不再存在黑底 PiP 图标 fallback

因此即使系统 transition 有异常，也不会再把我们自己的 PiP 图标漏出来。

### 2. 关闭 PiP 后回 App，要几秒才能出现画面

这次日志也完全解释清楚了。

关闭 PiP：

```text
12:38:43.104
pause-and-suspend committed

12:38:43.933
PiP system stopped
```

你重新回 App 后，其实 MPV 很快就已经处于：

```text
currentVID=1
currentVO=gpu-next
viewportReady=true

actual=2783.283
target=2783.193
差值只有 0.09 秒
```

也就是说：

**视频轨已经恢复、viewport 已经正常、位置也完全正确。**

但 Build167 的 fresh-frame 逻辑还要求：

```text
playback-restart
或者
video-pts
```

问题是你点 X 后我们按照正确语义把播放器暂停了：

```text
playback=paused
```

暂停状态下 MPV 很可能：

- 不产生新的 `playback-restart`
- 也没有持续更新 `video-pts`

因此明明画面条件已经满足，我们却一直判：

```text
ready=false
```

一直硬等到：

```text
12:38:47.937
fresh-frame-timeout
```

这正好是大约 **2.5 秒**。

然后 retry：

```text
12:38:48.062
重新 surface replay

12:38:48.084
ready=true
```

第二次只用了约：

**22ms**

所以不是 MPV 真恢复要几秒，而是我们第一次在等一个**暂停状态下根本不一定会发生的事件**。

Build168 改成：

当播放器是暂停状态时，只要同时满足：

```text
video track enabled
+
currentVO = gpu-next
+
viewport valid
+
time-pos 有效
+
当前位置与目标位置匹配
```

就允许认定：

```text
pausedFrameSignal=true
```

不再死等 `playback-restart/video-pts`。

因此正常情况下这条路径应该从原来的：

```text
约 2.5 秒 timeout
+ retry
```

变成：

```text
viewport / surface settle
≈ 几十毫秒级
```

然后立即显示暂停画面。

## Assistant

现在根因已经够明确，可以改了，而且这次比前几轮更聚焦：

- **方向不是“2 秒后才转横屏”**：日志显示点击返回后的第一时刻 App 已经是 `actual=3`、窗口 `932×430`，也就是横屏。你看到的“先竖向再横向”是 AVKit 恢复画布先走 `430×181`，约 0.74 秒后才到 `931×392`；之所以视觉上拖到 2 秒左右，是因为我们的 renderer handoff 第一次根本没有真正触发 MPV renderer refresh，等 2.5 秒 timeout 后 retry 才 kick 成功。
- **返回后的 1–2 秒卡住/追赶**也是同一个原因：三次返回都几乎固定在第一次 restore **2.52 秒超时**，然后 retry 只要约 0.19–0.47 秒就成功。
- **X 后回 App 仍要约 1.7 秒**：Build168 的 pausedFrameSignal 已经生效，但真正阻塞的是 `viewportReady=false`。视频轨位置完全正确、`vid=1`、`gpu-next` 都正常，就是第一次 surface replay 没把 MPVRenderer 真正刷新起来。

我已经定位到具体代码错误：`PlayerSurfacePresentationGate.replay()` 虽然发了通知，但 `MPVSurface` 只有在 `armRelease()` 后才把 `lastReportedGeometry` 清空并重新上报 geometry；所以所谓“replay”第一轮其实只做了 UIView/CAMetalLayer layout，**没有触发 `rendererSurfaceDidSettle → MPVRenderer refresh`**。这正好解释控制中心为什么能救活——控制中心制造一次新的 foreground layout，间接触发了真正的 renderer refresh。

我现在做 Build169，只修这条 replay 握手和 AVKit 最后一帧交接；PiP Seek 继续冻结。

{"path":"/GitHub/link_6a76205e1a548191a3664f865c5e7a99/create_file","args":{"branch":"fix/pip-surface-replay-0.14.2","content":"# OnePlayer 0.14.2 Build169\n\n- PiP fast seek remains frozen in this round; the previously observed long-latency seek is intentionally deferred.\n- Fixes the core PiP renderer replay bug: PlayerSurfacePresentationGate now has an explicit replay generation, and MPVSurface invalidates/reports geometry on every replay even before presentation release is armed.\n- This makes the first PiP return/paused-foreground replay immediately reach RendererLayoutCoordinator and MPVRenderer instead of doing only UIView/CAMetalLayer layout and waiting for a 2.5 s resume timeout before retry.\n- Return-to-player keeps the SampleBuffer bridge and black presentation cover until AVKit pictureInPictureControllerDidStopPictureInPicture has fired and MPV renderer is ready.\n- Final AVKit -> MPV visual ownership changes on the next CADisplayLink tick after didStop, then sourceHost is hidden and presentation release is armed. This is a display-cycle barrier, not an arbitrary millisecond delay, and is intended to prevent the last AVKit transition frame from leaking into the first inline MPV frame.\n- Logs now distinguish explicit gate replay, renderer-ready-before-system-stop, and next-vsync final handoff.\n- App orientation remains locked to the final landscape target throughout restore. Build168 logs confirmed the app window was already 932x430 / landscape at restore start; the visible 430x181 -> 931x392 phase is AVKit transition-surface geometry, not a delayed landscape request.\n- Build168 paused-frame signal, Build167 vid=no background suspension and PiP X=pauseAndSuspend, Build166 shared Wi-Fi/cellular cache, MPV native absolute+keyframes seek, and STRM -> 302 -> 115 client-direct transport remain unchanged.\n- Deployment Target remains iOS 15.0; iOS 17.0 remains supported.\n","message":"Docs: add Build169 PiP surface replay changelog","path":"docs/changelog/CHANGELOG_v0_14_2_build169.md","repository_full_name":"white-shark-ssw/emby-playerlab"}}

Therefore the first replay usually does UIView/CAMetalLayer layout only and does not call rendererSurfaceDidSettle -> RendererLayoutCoordinator -> MPVRenderer refresh.\n- PiP X -> foreground restore is blocked by the same issue: vid=1, gpu-next and paused time-pos are valid, but viewportReady remains false for ~1.7s because first replay does not actually refresh MPVRenderer.\n- The one-frame PiP residue persists after Build168 removed the custom placeholder and hid sourceHost before cover release, so it is now attributed to the final AVKit transition layer/compositor frame rather than our custom PiP glyph.\n\nBuild169:\n- Add explicit presentation replayGeneration to PlayerSurfacePresentationGate.\n- MPVSurface invalidates/resubmits geometry on every explicit replay generation, before release is armed, forcing the first replay through RendererLayoutCoordinator/MPVRenderer.\n- For return-to-player, renderer readiness no longer immediately hides sourceHost or arms cover release.\n- Wait for AVKit didStop and rendererReady, then use one CADisplayLink tick as a compositor barrier. ## Assistant

这次两份 Build168 日志把问题进一步收紧了，尤其你问的“为什么先竖向，过一两秒才横向”，现在可以明确回答：

**这不是正常应该接受的等待，也不是 App 真的两秒后才请求横屏。**

日志里三次返回播放器，在 return 一开始 App 就已经是：

```text
interfaceOrientation = 3
window = 932 × 430
```

也就是播放器窗口本身已经处于横屏。

但 AVKit 的恢复画布随后走的是：

```text
+0.267s   render-size = 430 × 181
约 +1.0s  render-size = 931 × 392
```

所以你肉眼看到的“先竖再横”，本质上是 **AVKit 的 PiP transition surface 先按竖屏宽度展开，再切到最终横屏尺寸**。

真正把这个现象拖得明显的，是我们自己的 renderer handoff。

Build168 三次返回几乎完全重复同一个失败模式：

```text
开始返回
↓
第一次 surface replay
↓
MPV 的位置一直正常向前
但 viewportReady=false
↓
固定约 2.52 秒
fresh-frame timeout
↓
retry replay
↓
只要约 0.19～0.47 秒
renderer 就 ready
↓
画面恢复
```

这说明不是网络、缓存或者解码真的需要两三秒。

我最后找到的代码错误非常具体：

```swift
PlayerSurfacePresentationGate.replay()
```

虽然我们叫它 `replay`，但 Build168 的 `MPVSurface` 只有在：

```swift
armRelease()
```

之后才清除 `lastReportedGeometry`。

结果第一次 `replay()` 实际只是：

```text
UIView layout
CAMetalLayer frame 更新
```

**并没有再次调用：**

```text
rendererSurfaceDidSettle
→ RendererLayoutCoordinator
→ MPVRenderer refresh
```

所以第一次恢复实际上没有真正 kick MPV renderer。

这同时解释了你现在三个现象：

**返回播放器 1～2 秒卡住/追赶、看起来晚转横屏、X 后回 App 仍需约 1.5 秒出图。**

X 那一次尤其清楚：

```text
12:58:19.343  开始 paused foreground restore
12:58:19.352  vid=1 已恢复

currentVO=gpu-next

播放位置完全正确

之后一直：
viewportReady=false

12:58:21.037
viewportReady=true
ready=true
```

实际浪费：

**约 1.69 秒。**

所以 Build168 虽然修掉了“等 playback-restart”的 2.5 秒错误，但真正剩下的瓶颈是 **renderer viewport 第一轮没有被刷新**。

你说“关闭 PiP 后等一会再回 App，出图会快很多”，也符合这个 renderer/video pipeline 生命周期竞争现象。

## Build169 已针对这个根因完成

版本：

```text
OnePlayer 0.14.2
Build169

branch:
fix/pip-surface-replay-0.14.2

PR #230
Draft / Open / 未合并

head:
2f143d781606d343c504fbc0ee1ed7d5e96bb13f
```

这次 Presentation Gate 增加独立：

```swift
replayGeneration
```

每次：

```swift
PlayerSurfacePresentationGate.replay()
```

都会产生新的 replay generation。

`MPVSurface` 收到新 generation 后立即：

```text
清空 lastReportedGeometry
↓
重新 layout
↓
重新上报 geometry
↓
rendererSurfaceDidSettle
↓
RendererLayoutCoordinator
↓
MPVRenderer refresh
```

注意：

**这发生在黑色 presentation cover 还盖着的时候。**

所以目标顺序现在是真正：

```text
最终横屏 geometry
↓
黑盖保持
↓
第一轮立即 kick MPV renderer
↓
恢复 vid
↓
viewport / fresh frame ready
↓
再进入最终画面交接
```

而不是 Build168：

```text
所谓 replay
↓
其实没刷新 renderer
↓
傻等 2.5 秒
↓
retry
↓
第二次才真正刷新
```

### 那一帧 PiP 黑底/线条为什么 Build168 还存在？

这一轮也得到了一个重要反证。

Build168 已经：

- 删除了我们自己的 PiP placeholder 图标；
- 在 presentation cover release **之前**隐藏 sourceHost。

结果你仍然看到那一帧。

因此之前“是我们自己的 sourceHost 残留”的判断已经可以排除。

现在更符合日志的是：

> **那是 AVKit PiP transition layer 最后一帧仍在 compositor 中。**

也就是系统 `didStop` 和真正从屏幕合成树撤掉 PiP transition surface，并不保证恰好发生在同一个显示刷新周期。

Build169 不再使用毫秒延时。

现在要求：

```text
MPV renderer ready
+
AVKit didStop
↓
都满足
↓
等待下一次 CADisplayLink tick
↓
即下一个真实屏幕刷新周期
↓
隐藏 sourceHost
↓
arm presentation release
↓
显示 MPV
```

这是一个**显示周期 barrier**，不是：

```text
delay 50ms
delay 100ms
```

这种猜时间。

目的就是确保：

> AVKit 最后一帧先彻底退出 compositor，再把 MPV 暴露出来。

如果 Build169 仍然能看到完全相同的一帧，那么下一步就可以更确定这是 AVKit 系统动画自身不可完全消除的内容，而不是我们的 layer 生命周期。

---

### 关于“返回时应该自然就是横屏”

你的理解基本正确。

至少从 OnePlayer 自己的状态来看，点击返回时播放器已经锁定：

```text
landscape mask
interfaceOrientation=3
window=932×430
```

所以我们不应该再增加任何“等两秒再旋转”的逻辑。

Build169 **没有增加新的 orientation delay**。

真正要做的是让 MPV renderer 在 AVKit 展开过程中就已经完成最终横屏 backing：

```text
2796 × 1290
```

这样 AVKit 那段：

```text
430×181 → 931×392
```

即使仍属于 iOS 的原生 transition animation，也不应该再被 renderer timeout 拖成你现在感受到的 2～3 秒过程。

理想情况下剩下的只是系统自身大约一秒以内的返回动画，而不是：

```text
系统动画
+
2.5 秒 renderer timeout
+
retry
```

继续按你的要求：

**Build169 完全没碰。**

CI 对以下内容做了冻结比较：

全部保持。

等 PiP 返回/恢复生命周期稳定以后，再单独处理那次超长 Seek，避免又把多个变量混在一起。

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 18)

def get_frame(t):

cap=cv2.VideoCapture(video)

cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC, t*1000)

ok, fr=cap.read()

cap.release()

if not ok: return None

fr=cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

return Image.fromarray(fr)

def make_sheet(times, cols=5, thumb=(443,204), path='/mnt/data/sheet.jpg'):

rows=math.ceil(len(times)/cols)

sheet=Image.new('RGB',(cols*thumb[0],rows*thumb[1]),'black')

for i,t in enumerate(times):

img=get_frame(t)

if img is None: continue

img=img.resize(thumb)

d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)

label=f"{t:05.2f}s"

d.rectangle((0,0,85,25), fill=(0,0,0))

d.text((4,3),label,font=font,fill='white')

sheet.paste(img,((i%cols)*thumb[0],(i//cols)*thumb[1]))

sheet.save(path,quality=90)

return path

### 返回播放器为什么还会卡 1～2 秒、像画面追赶

日志中第一次返回：

```text
13:32:11.261  MPVRenderer refresh begin
13:32:11.417  MPVViewport osd=0x0
13:32:11.427  MPVViewport osd=0x0
...
13:32:13.767  viewportReady=true
13:32:13.788  MPVViewport osd=2796x1290
```

也就是说：

> Build169 已经第一时间真正执行了 MPVRenderer refresh，但 MPV 自己在恢复 `vid=1` 后有约 **2.37 秒**没有有效视频输出尺寸。

与此同时 MPV 的播放时钟一直正常往前：

```text
2876.5
2877.x
2878.x
```

所以音频/时间轴没有卡住，真正卡住的是**视频输出重新建立**。

这也解释了你感觉“先卡住，然后突然追赶”：

- PiP/SampleBuffer 那边还在显示旧的可见画面；
- MPV 内部时间已经继续往前跑了两秒；
- 当 MPV 的 viewport 终于从 `0x0` 恢复成 `2796×1290` 时，画面一下切到当前时间；
- 肉眼就像画面突然追上音频。

所以这不是播放器真的“加速播放两秒”，而是**视觉层落后了两秒后一次性交接到实时 MPV**。

一直持续到：


耗时约：

所以 Build168/169 之前把注意力放在 `playback-restart`、surface replay 上，其实都只是外围。

```text

↓

↓
```

这才是回 App 出画面慢的核心。

所以现在可以确定：

因此 Build169 增加一个 CADisplayLink 再等一帧当然没有效果——我们控制不了 AVKit 自己那个 layer 的最后几帧。

下一步如果还要消掉它，不能再：


## “先竖屏，后横屏”这次录屏也看清楚了

录屏里大约：

```text
5.9s ～ 7.0s
```

画面是一个很窄的竖向视频条，黑底。

然后：

```text
7.1s ～ 7.7s
```

开始旋转、放大到横屏。

但日志里点击返回的第一时刻已经是：

```text
actualOrientation = 3
window = 932×430
mask = landscape
```

所以 **OnePlayer 本身并没有晚两秒才申请横屏**。

原因有两部分：

第一，iPhone 的 Home Screen 本身是 portrait coordinate space。PiP 从桌面返回一个横屏播放器，iOS 必然需要做一次：

```text
Portrait Home
↓
Landscape App
```

系统旋转。

这一部分不能完全消灭。

但第二部分，也就是为什么你感觉它明显拖到接近 2 秒，是我们的恢复流程把 AVKit transition 和 MPV renderer 恢复绑在了一起。

AVKit 日志：

```text
430×181
↓
931×392
```

而 MPV 这时候 viewport 又一直是：

```text
0×0
```

所以系统 transition 在等/展示替代画面，整体体验显得特别拖。

**正常不应该等 2 秒。**

正确目标应该是：

> 系统做它正常的一次 portrait-home → landscape-player 动画，但播放器视频从动画开始到结束始终连续，不等 MPV 重新建 viewport。

# 所以下一步架构我认为已经非常明确

我不建议继续做 Build170 的“小修”。

现在应该改变 return 的视觉所有权。

### 返回播放器

不要再：

```text
点返回
↓
恢复 vid=1
↓
等 MPV viewport 1.8~2.5 秒
↓
MPV ready
↓
才真正让播放器出现
```

而应该：

```text
PiP 点击返回
↓
SampleBuffer pipeline 继续播放
↓
AVKit 返回 OnePlayer
↓
OnePlayer 全屏仍然显示同一个 SampleBuffer 画面
↓
系统旋转完成
↓
此时用户一直看到连续视频
↓
后台慢慢恢复 MPV vid=1
↓
MPV viewport 2796×1290
↓
确认 fresh frame
↓
再无缝/短 crossfade 切回 MPV
```

换句话说：

> **MPV 恢复慢可以慢，但不能再让用户等它。**

这会同时改善：

- 返回后 1～2 秒卡住；
- “追赶感”；
- 竖→横过程拖得很久；
- MPV viewport 重建慢带来的黑屏。

---

### PiP X → 手动回 App

这条路径也是同样原则。

现在 X 后我们把 SampleBuffer pipeline/sourceHost 销毁了。

于是用户马上回 App：

```text
只能看到黑盖
↓
等 MPV vid=1 重建 1.8 秒
↓
出图
```

更合理的是：

```text
X
↓
播放暂停
↓
SampleBuffer pipeline 也暂停
↓
保留最后可见 SampleBuffer / sourceHost
↓
App 自然 suspend
```

用户重新打开 App：

```text
立即显示关闭 PiP 时最后那一帧
↓
仍然 paused
↓
后台恢复 MPV vid
↓
MPV ready
↓
切回 MPV
```

这样即使 MPV 还是需要 1.8 秒恢复，用户也不会看到黑屏。

而且保留一个**暂停的 SampleBuffer display layer**并不会要求 App 一直后台运行，不会违背你定义的：

> 关闭 PiP = 暂停 + App 由 iOS 自然挂起。

The previously observed long-latency PiP seek is recorded for later dedicated work.\n- Replaces the \u201cwait for MPV, then finish AVKit return\u201d handoff with a persistent SampleBuffer visual bridge.\n- Return-to-player now accepts AVKit restore as soon as the app is active, final landscape geometry is ready, and the inline SampleBuffer host is laid out. MPV renderer readiness is no longer a prerequisite for system restore completion.\n- After AVKit returns to the full-screen player, the same SampleBuffer pipeline remains visible and continues normal video playback while MPV restores its selected video track and gpu-next viewport underneath.\n- MPV still owns audio, playback state, and the authoritative timeline. SampleBuffer remains a visual replica only.\n- When MPV renderer is genuinely ready and PlayerSurfacePresentationGate has released its black cover, the SampleBuffer bridge crossfades to MPV over 100 ms, then the PiP pipelines and host are destroyed.\n- AVKit didStop no longer removes the PiP host or completes visual ownership transfer. It only marks the native PiP transition as finished; the bridge stays live until MPV handoff succeeds.\n- PiP X retains the last displayed SampleBuffer frame after pausing. It continues video playback while MPV vid/gpu-next/viewport recover underneath.\n- MPV remains audio owner, playback-state owner, and authoritative timeline.\n- Once MPV renderer is ready and PlayerSurfacePresentationGate has released, crossfade the SampleBuffer visual bridge to MPV over 100ms, then destroy PiP pipelines/host.\n- AVKit didStop only marks native transition completion; it no longer destroys visual bridge state.\n- PiP X stops FFmpeg/SampleBuffer background work but preserves the last displayed SampleBuffer frame and host. ## Assistant

Build170 已经完成，正式测试包可以用了。这一轮没有继续优化 PiP Seek，而是把**返回播放器/X 后回 App 的视觉所有权重新设计**了。

核心变化是：**不再让 AVKit 等 MPV 的 1.8～2.5 秒 viewport 恢复。**现在点“返回播放器”后，只要 App 已前台、最终横屏 geometry 和 SampleBuffer host 已就位，就立即允许 AVKit 完成系统返回。回到全屏以后，画面继续由当前 SampleBuffer pipeline 显示并正常播放；MPV 在它下面恢复 `vid=1 / gpu-next / viewport`。等 MPV 真正 ready，再用 **100ms crossfade** 从 SampleBuffer 平滑切回 MPV，然后才销毁 PiP pipeline。

这意味着即使 MPV 还是需要两秒恢复，理论上用户也不应该再看到“画面卡两秒然后追赶”，因为这两秒应该继续看到 PiP 同一条视频画面。

PiP 的 X 也改成了同样思路。点击 X 后依然是你确认的：

`暂停播放 → App 留后台 → iOS 自然 suspend`

但 Build170 不再把 `AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer` 的最后画面 `flushAndRemoveImage()` 掉。FFmpeg/SampleBuffer pipeline 会停止，不继续后台解码和下载，但**最后显示的那一帧和 sourceHost 会保留**。你马上重新打开 App 时，第一眼应该先看到关闭 PiP 时的暂停画面；MPV 在下面恢复，ready 后再 crossfade 回 MPV。

这轮还把返回流程里的竞态处理了：手动点 App 图标和 AVKit `restoreUserInterface` 两个回调即使先后到达，系统 restore completion 也不会重复或悬空。

PiP Seek、MPV `absolute+keyframes`、Build167 的 `vid=no`、Build166 的 Wi-Fi/蜂窝共享缓存，以及 STRM → 302 → 115 直连全部冻结，没有改。
